summary: Investigated a report that switching threads should update the header and extensions inspectors to the correct project. Explored SessionCapability.ts, App.svelte, and SessionSidebar.svelte to trace switchSession → enterWorkspace, then ran Playwright reproductions against the live app: created a scratch thread in recipes-repo and switched between it and the jev-melee thread, observing titlebar, header, inspector title, inspector tabs, and inspector panel content. Could not reproduce the bug because all workspaces share identical extension configuration.
